text: GTA 6 has been out for four days, and streamers are already breaking it. Today we've got a mystery reflection, a stolen bicycle, and one swamp trip that ends in a way nobody saw coming. Stick around for that one. It's the best of the day.
First up, Leerik. He just moved some money around and he's feeling pretty proud of himself. Keep an eye on the shop window.
Grove Street, is that you? Rockstar, we need answers.
Jerma needs cash for rent, and he has a plan. The plan involves an old car, a dirt road, and zero patience.
Rent? Still due. Car? Still kind of in one piece.
Fooslee has been training Jason at the punching bag, and Jason is getting huge. So she decides to compare arms with him.
Real life gains are still loading.
Joe Bartolozzi is living the true Florida life. He finds a new friend on the sidewalk, and he wants to share it with everyone.
Rest in peace, little guy. Vice City police do not brake for birds.
Lacy has been streaming GTA 6 for days. Then one viewer shows up in chat with a very reasonable request.
Ninety hours of progress, for one viewer. That's customer service.
Woolie is in the middle of a shootout when he ducks into a little shed for cover. Watch the walls.
He saw the bug on Twitter, and the game said: your turn.
Dunk found a bicycle and decided it's his now. There's just one problem. He has no idea how you save a bike in this game.
Dunk, the accidental bike thief of Leonida.
And the best one for last. Jay Shrobs is out in the swamp with his binoculars, watching some locals. Something about them feels off.
That's it for today. If this made you laugh, hit subscribe, because we're back tomorrow with more GTA 6 chaos. And tell me in the comments which moment was your favorite.
